mapper.select: SELECT c.campaign_id, c.campaign_Title, c.recruitment_Num, c.applicants_Num, c.type_code, f.saved_name, f.file_path, CASE WHEN c.type_code = '01' THEN '경호' WHEN c.type_code = '02' THEN '진행' WHEN c.type_code = '03' THEN '수행' ELSE '' END AS type_Nm, CASE WHEN c.uc_choice = '01' THEN '캠페인 포인트' WHEN c.uc_choice = '02' THEN '유저 포인트' ELSE '' END AS uc_Choice, c.campaign_pay, c.app_period_str, c.app_period_end, c.event_Period_str, c.event_Period_End, c.time_segment, cl.user_nm FROM campaign c LEFT OUTER JOIN files f ON c.campaign_id = f.target_id AND f.is_deleted = 'N' AND f.target_type = 'campaign' LEFT OUTER JOIN camp_leader cl ON c.campaign_id = cl.campaign_id AND cl.is_deleted = 'N' -- 리더 삭제 여부 조건 추가 WHERE c.is_deleted = 'N' AND c.app_Period_end >= CURDATE() AND c.applicants_Num <= c.recruitment_Num AND c.is_active = 'Y' GROUP BY c.campaign_id, f.SAVED_NAME, f.FILE_PATH, cl.user_nm-- 중복 방지를 위해 그룹화 ORDER BY c.applicants_Num DESC, c.campaign_id DESC

SELECT c.campaign_id, c.campaign_Title, c.recruitment_Num, c.applicants_Num, c.type_code, f.saved_name, f.file_path, (CASE WHEN type_code = '01' THEN '경호' WHEN type_code = '02' THEN '진행' WHEN type_code = '03' THEN '수행' ELSE '' END) as typeNm, campaign_pay, c.app_period_str, c.app_period_end, event_Period_str, event_Period_End, time_segment, cl.user_nm FROM campaign c LEFT OUTER JOIN files f ON c.campaign_id = f.target_id LEFT OUTER JOIN camp_leader cl on c.campaign_id = cl.campaign_id Where f.is_deleted = 'N' and f.target_type = 'campaign' and c.is_deleted = 'N' and c.app_Period_End > CURDATE() and c.applicants_Num <= 1 and c.is_active = 'Y' ORDER BY campaign_id asc

SELECT c.campaign_id, c.campaign_Title, c.recruitment_Num, c.applicants_Num, c.type_code, f.saved_name, f.file_path, (CASE WHEN type_code = '01' THEN '경호' WHEN type_code = '02' THEN '진행' WHEN type_code = '03' THEN '수행' ELSE '' END) as typeNm, campaign_pay, c.app_period_str, c.app_period_end, event_Period_str, event_Period_End, time_segment, cl.user_nm FROM campaign c LEFT OUTER JOIN files f ON c.campaign_id = f.target_id LEFT OUTER JOIN camp_leader cl on c.campaign_id = cl.campaign_id Where f.is_deleted = 'N' and f.target_type = 'campaign' and c.app_Period_End > CURDATE() and c.is_deleted = 'N' and c.is_active = 'Y' ORDER BY c.created_at desc

select campaign_id, company_Nm, company_Ph, campaign_Title, recruitment_Num, applicants_Num, place_Addr, mission,
app_period_str, app_period_end, event_period_str, event_period_end, time_segment, result_date
from campaign where campaign_id = #{id} and is_deleted = 'N' and is_active = 'Y'
SELECT campaign_id, applied_str_date, applied_end_date FROM user_campaign WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT c.campaign_id, c.campaign_Title, c.recruitment_Num, c.applicants_Num, f.saved_name, f.file_path, c.app_period_str, c.app_period_end, c.event_Period_str, c.event_Period_End, time_segment, (CASE WHEN type_code = '01' THEN '경호' WHEN type_code = '02' THEN '진행' WHEN type_code = '03' THEN '수행' ELSE '' END) as type_nm, cl.user_nm, c.campaign_pay, DATE_FORMAT(c.created_at, '%Y.%m.%d') as created_at FROM campaign c LEFT OUTER JOIN files f ON c.campaign_id = f.target_id LEFT OUTER JOIN camp_leader cl on c.campaign_id = cl.campaign_id and c.is_deleted = 'N' Where f.is_deleted = 'N' and c.app_Period_End >= CURDATE() and c.is_deleted = 'N' and is_active = 'Y' and f.target_type = 'campaign'
ORDER BY c.created_At DESC, c.campaign_id desc
ORDER BY c.applicants_Num DESC, c.campaign_id desc
ORDER BY ABS(DATEDIFF(App_Period_End, CURDATE())) ASC, c.campaign_id desc;
and applicants_Num = 0 ORDER BY c.created_At DESC, c.campaign_id desc

select uc.campaign_id, uc.user_id, uc.user_No, u.user_nm, u.phone_Num, c.campaign_title, c.event_period_str, c.event_period_end, c.company_nm, c.company_ph, c.recruitment_num, applicants_Num, (CASE WHEN c.type_code = '01' THEN '경호' WHEN c.type_code = '02' THEN '진행' WHEN c.type_code = '03' THEN '수행' ELSE '' END) as type_nm, (CASE WHEN uc.status = '0' THEN '신청 대기' WHEN uc.status = '1' THEN '선정 완료' WHEN uc.status = '2' THEN '참여 완료' WHEN uc.status = '3' THEN '정산 완료' ELSE '없음' END) as status_nm, c.app_period_str, c.app_period_end, c.event_Period_str, c.event_Period_End, time_segment, result_date, place_addr from user_campaign uc left outer join user u on uc.user_id = u.user_id left outer join campaign c on uc.campaign_id = c.campaign_id where uc.campaign_id=#{id};
SELECT c.* FROM campaign c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM files f WHERE f.target_id = c.campaign_id)
SELECT count(*) FROM campaign where is_deleted = 'N'
SELECT DISTINCT apply_date FROM user_campaign WHERE campaign_id = #{campaignId}
mapper.update: UPDATE campaign SET is_active = 'N', updated_at = NOW() WHERE is_active = 'Y' AND is_deleted = 'N' AND campaign_id = #{campaignId}
mapper.select: SELECT banner_id, url, title FROM banner WHERE is_deleted = 'N' ORDER BY banner_id
